markup.[[x]]: 重点形式：这个语法要你注意的词（橙底）
markup.{x}: 变化的部分：只用在 [[ ]] 里，例如 work{s}（橙底里加粗下划线）
markup.((x)): 变回原形的动词（虚线下划线）
markup.~~x~~: 错句里错的部分（删除线）

idea.title: 一句话说清
idea.text: 分词作状语就是**把两句话压成一句**：前半句去掉 when、because 和开头的「谁」，动词变成 -ing 或 -ed。前提是：**两半句说的是同一个人或东西**。

uses.en: [[Walking]] to the office, I saw an old friend.
uses.en_zh: 走去办公室的路上，我碰到了一个老朋友。

uses.en: [[Feeling]] tired, I went to bed early.
uses.en_zh: 因为觉得累，我早早就睡了。

uses.en: [[Written]] in Swift, the app runs really fast.
uses.en_zh: 这个 App 是用 Swift 写的，跑得特别快。

ing.title: 用 -ing：自己在做
ing.rule: 主语**自己做**这个动作，用 -ing。它可以表示「……的时候」「一边……」或者「因为……」。

examples.en: [[Opening]] the app, I noticed a new icon.
examples.zh: 打开 App 的时候，我注意到一个新图标。

examples.en: [[Not knowing]] the password, she called the IT desk.
examples.zh: 她不知道密码，就给 IT 打了电话。

examples.en: He sat at his desk, [[reading]] the release notes.
examples.zh: 他坐在桌前，看着发布说明。

notes: 否定把 not 放在最前面：[[Not having]] a key, I waited outside.（没带钥匙，我就在外面等。）

ed.title: 用 -ed：被做的
ed.rule: 主语是**被别人做**的，用过去分词（-ed 或不规则的那个形式）。可以想成前面藏了一个「被」。

examples.en: [[Built]] in 2010, the office needs a new lift.
examples.zh: 这栋办公楼建于 2010 年，需要换新电梯了。

examples.en: [[Shocked]] by the news, nobody said a word.
examples.zh: 大家被这个消息惊呆了，谁都没说话。

examples.en: [[Tested]] on real devices, the update is ready to ship.
examples.zh: 这次更新在真机上测过了，可以发布了。

having.title: 先做完再……：having done
having.rule: 第一件事**做完了**，才有第二件事，用 having + 过去分词，意思是「做完……之后」。

examples.en: [[Having finished]] the report, she went home.
[[Having fixed]] the bug, we ran all the tests again.
examples.zh: 修完 bug 后，我们把测试又全跑了一遍。

examples.en: [[Having lived]] in London, he knows the Tube well.
examples.zh: 他在伦敦住过，所以很熟悉地铁。

conj.title: 带上 when / after
conj.rule: 怕意思不清楚，可以把 **when、while、after、before** 留下来，后面直接接 -ing。这样说更清楚，口语也常用。

examples.en: [[While waiting]] for the build, I made a cup of tea.
examples.zh: 等构建的时候，我泡了杯茶。

examples.en: [[Before leaving]], please turn off the lights.
[[After talking]] to the client, we changed the plan.
examples.zh: 和客户聊过之后，我们改了计划。

wrong.bad: ~~After finished~~ lunch, we went back to work.
wrong.good: [[After finishing]] lunch, we went back to work.

that.meaning: 从句：长一点，聊天更常用
that.en: [[Because she felt]] ill, she stayed at home.

this.en: [[Writing]] the report, I found a mistake.

that.en: [[Written]] in a hurry, the report had mistakes.

commonMistakes.bad: ~~Walking into the office, the coffee machine~~ was broken.
commonMistakes.good: [[Walking]] into the office, I saw that the coffee machine was broken.
commonMistakes.why: 前后得是同一个主语：走进办公室的是我，不是咖啡机。

commonMistakes.bad: ~~Writing~~ in 2019, the code is hard to read now.
commonMistakes.good: [[Written]] in 2019, the code is hard to read now.
[[Having finished]] the work, I went home.
commonMistakes.why: 是我自己做完的，用 having finished。

commonMistakes.bad: Knowing ~~not~~ the answer, I kept quiet.
commonMistakes.good: [[Not knowing]] the answer, I kept quiet.

quiz.prompt: ___ tired, I went to bed early.
用 -ing 分词改写：When I opened the app, I noticed a new icon.
quiz.answer: Opening the app, I noticed a new icon.
accept: When opening the app, I noticed a new icon.
quiz.explain: 去掉 when 和 I，动词变 -ing：[[Opening]]。

quiz.prompt: ___ (not know) the password, she called the IT desk.
accept: not knowing

traps.note: not 要放在 -ing 前面：Not knowing。

quiz.prompt: He sat at his desk, ___ (read) the release notes.
___ in 2010, the office building needs a new lift.
___ (test) on real devices, the update is ready to ship.
accept: tested

quiz.prompt: 改错：Writing in 2019, the code is hard to read now.
quiz.answer: Written in 2019, the code is hard to read now.

quiz.prompt: 用 having 改写：After she had finished the report, she went home.
quiz.answer: Having finished the report, she went home.
accept: After finishing the report, she went home.

quiz.prompt: ___ the bug, we ran all the tests again.
While ___ (wait) for the build, I made a cup of tea.
改错：After finished lunch, we went back to the meeting.
quiz.answer: After finishing lunch, we went back to the meeting.
accept: Having finished lunch, we went back to the meeting.
After we finished lunch, we went back to the meeting.
After we had finished lunch, we went back to the meeting.
After lunch, we went back to the meeting.

quiz.prompt: 改错：Walking into the office, the coffee machine was broken.
quiz.answer: Walking into the office, I saw that the coffee machine was broken.
accept: Walking into the office, I saw the coffee machine was broken.
Walking into the office, I found the coffee machine was broken.
Walking into the office, I found that the coffee machine was broken.
When I walked into the office, the coffee machine was broken.
quiz.explain: 走进来的是「我」，主句要用 I 开头。

quiz.prompt: ___ in a hurry, the report had lots of mistakes.
改回完整的句子（用 because）：Feeling ill, she stayed at home.
quiz.answer: Because she felt ill, she stayed at home.
accept: She stayed at home because she felt ill.
Because she was feeling ill, she stayed at home.
She stayed at home because she was feeling ill.
Because she felt ill, she stayed home.
quiz.explain: 把主语和时态补回来：[[Because she felt]] ill。

quiz.prompt: 翻译：走去办公室的路上，我碰到了一个老朋友。（用 -ing 开头）
quiz.answer: Walking to the office, I met an old friend.
accept: Walking to the office, I ran into an old friend.
Walking to the office, I bumped into an old friend.
Walking to the office, I saw an old friend.
Walking to work, I met an old friend.
Walking to work, I ran into an old friend.
quiz.explain: 我自己在走，用 [[Walking]]，主句主语也是 I。

openTask.prompt: 写 3 句话讲你最近的一天，每句都用分词开头：一句用 -ing，一句用 -ed，一句用 having done。
rules: 分词的动作和主句是同一个主语
自己做用 -ing，被做用过去分词，先做完用 having + 过去分词
openTask.note: 规则判分词形式和主语是否一致（计分）；离线模型给更自然的说法（AI 建议，不计分）
